Hanna (People Ops): Quick Q 1: Marcus just became temporary guardian for his 10yo niece starting 2026-04-05. She needs to be added to his dependent coverage. What docs do we accept and is this a QLE?
Marcus R: We have a temporary guardianship order (signed 4/4), school registration in my address dated 4/6, and a note from CPS caseworker. Is that enough?
Olivia - Benefits: That sounds like a qualifying life event (change in household/custody). For temporary guardianship we usually need: (1) court order or guardianship paperwork, (2) proof of residence (school or mail), and (3) if prior coverage existed, proof of loss. CPS note helps. Send via secure portal, do not slack attachments.
Marcus R: Can coverage be effective 4/5 or does it have to wait until next month? Also worried about having to show birth certificate and SSN right away.
Olivia - Benefits: Effective date can be the date of the event (4/5) if docs substantiate. We typically require SSN and birth certificate for dependent enrollment; you can upload those after initial QLE docs if needed but SSN is required before benefits ID card issuance. Use https://hr.redwood.com/upload and select the "QLE - Guardianship" category.
DocUploadBot: Reminder  Uploads must be PDF/PNG under 10MB. Do not include full SSN on non-secure channels.
Marcus R: Got it. I'll upload the court order and school docs now. Any payroll impact for retro coverage?
Olivia - Benefits: If retro effective date approved, payroll will reconcile premiums retroactively. They can spread adjustments across upcoming pays if you prefer. We'll confirm once review is complete.
Legal Intake: Small note  temporary guardianship documentation can vary by state. If benefits team needs verification, Legal can confirm authenticity if you attach a redacted copy to the secure intake.
Hanna (People Ops): I'll track the 30-day QLE window and mark Marcus's file. Marcus, ping here after upload and @Olivia will confirm review.
Marcus R: Uploaded. @Olivia please confirm when you see it.
Olivia - Benefits: Received  starting review. Should have a decision by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
